title: Underground Monk Show at @Assembly Festival ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ is a fantastic...
transcript: The key to a great clowning show are hilarious bits and a satisfying structure, and Underground Monk Show absolutely delivers on those fronts. What a fantastic show to end my first day here at the Fringe. Underground Monk Show takes you on four different monks spiritual journeys, so to speak, as each of these monks go on sort of a. A. A vision quest in to a bowl of holy water. Each of the four performers in Underground Monk show bring something totally unique that meshes really well. The way that they play off of each other is delightful. And I think that if you are looking to get into clown shows here at the Edinburgh Fringe, which can be a little off beat, underground Monk show is a great first time clown show. Underground Monk show can be found at the Assembly, the Piccolo Theatre through the rest of the fringe.
